goal: 增加对 pi agent 的支持

summary.title: 增加 Pi agent session source 支持
summary.what: 新增 public `pi` session source adapter，接入 Pi JSONL inventory、parser、selector、sessionRef、cross-source find、文档与 skill schema，并把 public source 列表扩展为 codex / claude-code / pi。
summary.why: 用户已经 fork 了 Sherlog，并希望让 shlog 像支持 Codex 和 Claude Code 一样支持本机 Pi agent session 历史检索。
summary.user_goal: 增加对 pi agent 的支持

decisions.chose: 复用现有 source adapter 边界，新增 `src/sources/pi*` 文件并注册为 public adapter。
decisions.rationale: 这样可以沿用已有 selector、coverage、DB identity、query/read/list/stats 和 CLI source-aware 路径，降低与 Codex/Claude Code 行为漂移的风险。
rejected: 为 Pi 单独增加新命令或绕过现有 source registry

decisions.chose: 只把 user/assistant text blocks 写为 canonical messages，跳过 toolResult、thinking 和 toolCall；compaction summary 写入 session-level compactText。
decisions.rationale: Sherlog 可回读消息模型只支持 user/assistant，工具输出和推理块不应在 MVP 中成为可读 message projection；compaction summary 则适合参与 session-level recall。
rejected: 把 Pi toolResult 或 toolCall 内容也索引为普通消息

decisions.chose: 保持 Codex 为 non-find commands 和 bare sync 的默认 source，同时让 find 默认跨全部 public sources。
decisions.rationale: 保留既有首次安装和 Codex 工作流兼容性，同时让 Pi 能自然进入 source-aware recall。

decisions.chose: 更新 README、site、architecture docs、skill package references 和 JSON schema，但不发布 npm / 全局 skill。
decisions.rationale: 本次只完成源码和 PR 分支改动；正式 CLI/skill 发布需要单独 release/install 流程。

review_notes: 验证已通过 `npm run check`：29 files / 188 tests passed。
提交前已按用户要求运行 `git diff --cached --stat`、`git diff --cached --name-status` 和 `git diff --cached --check` 复核暂存内容。
本地仍有未跟踪的 `.cursor/`、`.pi/`、`.trellis/` agent/workflow 文件，未纳入提交；seal 使用 allow-dirty 仅记录该状态。
未进行 npm 发布、全局 shlog 更新或全局 sherlog skill 更新。

architectural_claims: Pi is a public SessionSourceAdapter using the existing source-aware adapter boundary.
Pi selectors support the same all/date_range/cwd/cwd_date_range canonical selector shapes as other public sources.
Pi read identity is source-qualified as `pi:<nativeSessionId>` to avoid cross-source collisions.
Cross-source find now includes Pi because it enumerates public adapters.
behavioral_changes: `--source pi` is accepted by status, sync, find, list, stats, read-range, and read-page through the existing public-source path.
Pi parser indexes only user/assistant text blocks and skips tool results, tool calls, and thinking blocks.
Pi compaction summaries participate in session-level recall through compactText.
Codex remains the default source for non-find commands and bare sync.

data_model_changes.name: SessionSourceId
data_model_changes.migration_notes: Existing source-aware SQLite schema stores source_id as text, so adding `pi` does not require schema migration.

security_implications: Pi toolResult/toolCall/thinking content is deliberately not projected into canonical messages to avoid leaking tool output or reasoning blocks through read commands.
migration_notes: Existing indexes remain valid; users must run `shlog sync --source pi` or scoped equivalents to index Pi sessions.
Global installed CLI/skill are unchanged until a separate release/install workflow updates them.
